summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated September 29, 2026, under which Capital Bancorp, Inc., parent of Capital Bank, N.A., will merge into Peoples, with Peoples surviving. Each Capital share converts into 1.11 Peoples shares, a stock-for-stock exchange ratio with no stated price or premium. Both boards unanimously approved. The transaction is intended as a Section 368(a) tax-free reorganization, followed by a bank merger into Peoples Bank. Equity awards vest and cancel for cash or stock consideration. Key risks include regulatory approvals, shareholder votes, and Synergy execution.
